scope: Sequential first reveals in 100 fresh synthetic processes each, Qt 6.8.2 offscreen/software, 100 tiles and 1000 in-memory catalog entries, with diagnostic timing enabled.
limitations: Fixed before/after order, no isolation of system load, no OS cache clearing, simulated platform adapters, no physical display or input. The profiler traces cover entire instrumented processes; nested ranges must not be summed as wall time. Raw child logs and profiler traces remain in local build directories.

summary.scope: fresh synthetic test processes with a real host and simulated platform
summary.boundary: first reveal after QGuiApplication exists; fixture time includes QML and catalog setup; process lifetime includes teardown; OS caches are not cleared and no physical input or display is measured
